# tanstack_ai_dart

> Unofficial Dart client for TanStack AI chat and generation.

Dart API 0.4.0; Dart SDK >=3.6.2 <4.0.0; @tanstack/ai-client 1.0.1; @tanstack/ai 1.0.1; upstream commit a7eb58459ebd528bbcc4166cc68377b777989462.

Use Dart constructors, enums, typed fetcher variants, and state streams.
Install from pub.dev with `dart pub add tanstack_ai_dart` or `flutter pub add tanstack_ai_dart`.
Server/provider adapters and
real device host implementations are outside this client package.

## Guides

- [Package overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seifalmotaz/tanstack-ai-dart/main/README.md): Installation and the shortest chat example.
- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seifalmotaz/tanstack-ai-dart/main/doc/README.md): Choose an application or maintainer guide.
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seifalmotaz/tanstack-ai-dart/main/doc/getting-started.md): Backend requirements, first request, ownership, and Flutter.
- [Chat and rendering](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seifalmotaz/tanstack-ai-dart/main/doc/chat.md): State streams, message parts, queues, and cancellation.
- [Connections and authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seifalmotaz/tanstack-ai-dart/main/doc/connections.md): HTTP, WebSocket, custom fetchers, and credential refresh.
- [Persistence and resume](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seifalmotaz/tanstack-ai-dart/main/doc/persistence.md): Server history, application storage, and replay.
- [Tools and interrupts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seifalmotaz/tanstack-ai-dart/main/doc/tools-and-interrupts.md): Typed tools, validation, approval, and continuation.
- [Generation and video](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seifalmotaz/tanstack-ai-dart/main/doc/generation.md): Typed results, restoration, and snapshot copiers.
- [Platform support](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seifalmotaz/tanstack-ai-dart/main/doc/platform-support.md): Host implementations, Flutter integration, and BYOK.
- [API reference map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seifalmotaz/tanstack-ai-dart/main/doc/api-reference.md): Public imports and common operations.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seifalmotaz/tanstack-ai-dart/main/doc/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose common setup and runtime failures.
